question: Why should a sign shop cost-plus markup multiplier differ by sign type (vinyl vs. aluminum vs. dimensional letters vs. pylon)?
summary: Derived that multiplier size should be inversely related to material cost share of true total job cost; corpus confirms this exact mechanism and ordering (vinyl ~10x, LED/dimensional 2.5-3.5x, aluminum/ACM 3-4x, pylon 1.8-2.5x).
